rca of the issue: iteration_29 fix for /notices/:ref?ui=e mobile overflow was incomplete. The `article.bg-white.border.p-8 { padding:20px }` and `main.flex-1 { min-width:0 }` rules did apply (verified in computed styles), but the parent CSS Grid (`.grid.gap-10.lg:grid-cols-[8fr_4fr]`) was auto-sizing its single mobile track to the max-content of its children. The H1 contained an unbreakable string 'TEST_committee_notice_2e17b6' at 40px which forced a 408.6px min-content — making the grid track 408.6px wide inside a 342px container, spilling 43px past viewport. Fix: force grid track to `minmax(0, 1fr)`, set min-width:0 on grid children, and add overflow-wrap:anywhere on H1.

critical_code_review_comments: The Notice Detail grid used auto-sized tracks that ignored container width. This is a common CSS-Grid pitfall — recommend adding `min-width:0` to grid children as a defensive pattern across other grid layouts in the codebase.
Multiple !important rules stacking up in @media block at index.css tail — could be consolidated into a mobile.css module for maintainability.
